data.name: Grave Whisperers
data.detailed_description:
A co-op horror experience set in a cursed pet cemetery, where your microphone becomes your worst enemy.
Every breath, whisper, or scream will draw the spirits closer. Can you and your friends solve all four terrifying cases?

Voice-Controlled Horror

The creatures are listening through your microphone. Whisper, breathe, or scream—and they will hear you. Lose control, and you lose the game.

Co-op Survival

1–4 players must gather clues, solve tasks, and escape from the relentless spirits of the graveyard. Silence is your strongest weapon.

Four Cursed Cases, Four Monsters

Each chapter features a unique monster. With its own hunting style, it will track you by sound, lure you into traps, and stalk you without mercy.
Every case introduces a new face of terror.

Special Vision Ability

Darkness surrounds you, but you are not entirely blind.
After completing each mission, you unlock a special vision that helps guide your way through the shadows.
But beware—seeing doesn’t always mean safety.

Dynamic AI Animals

The graveyard is alive with more than spirits. Animals roam the darkness:

  • They may flee when they see you.

  • Interact carelessly, and they might lead you into traps.
    This living ecosystem constantly tests your survival.

Puzzle and Locked Areas

Progress demands more than survival.
Solve puzzles to unlock hidden paths, break through locked areas, and uncover the cemetery’s dark secrets.
Every solved mystery brings you closer to the truth.

Psychological Health System

Forget traditional health bars. Instead, you must protect your sanity. Sudden frights and relentless chases drive you toward madness, while sedatives help restore your mind.

Found-Footage Atmosphere

VHS visuals, handheld camera effects, and photorealistic environments immerse you in a recorded nightmare—as if it already happened.

Dynamic Jumpscares

No two playthroughs are the same. Creatures adapt, and every scare feels different. Unexpected moments of horror keep you on edge.

Silent Communication

When speaking risks your life, use gestures and physical interactions to guide your friends. But one wrong sound could draw the nightmare to you.

Every Step Leaves a Mark

The graveyard is never silent. Every movement, every sound leaves a trace.
Spirits, animals, and cursed monsters are always listening.

Gather your friends. Stay silent. And survive the horror of Grave Whisperers.

data.short_description: Grave Whisperers is a co-op horror game set in a cursed pet cemetery. Stay silent or the creatures will hear you. Scream once and you’re dead. Gather clues, solve twisted cases with friends, and survive the nightmare that listens to every sound.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 570 equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone Required - Headset + SSD Highly Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X ／ Intel Core i5-12600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 12 GB / RX 6700 XT GAMING 12GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Microphone Required - Headset + SSD Highly Recommended

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of violence, blood, and disturbing imagery. Players may encounter corpses, dark environments, and psychological horror elements. Recommended for mature audiences.
